designationHistory.name: Mud Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Mud Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 7583; it was renamed Agassiz National Wildlife Refuge in 1961.
